study.question: Observation: selected g2-r0017-aligned_centroid has click AUC 0.6638436194 and model batch p50 30.0315ms, versus g2-r0015-task_union 0.6634628103 and 17.5918ms. The added second event moment does not win: aligned_event 0.6636942344 is below aligned_centroid, whereas rotated_event 0.6636377196 is slightly above rotated_centroid 0.6635882998; alignment/timing effects are small and inconsistent across cells at one seed. Previous learned encode-before/after-pool branch g2-r0008-encode_pool_blocked (0.6599379026) did not recover a convincing timing gain, and g2-r0010-full100 (0.6597487028) shows full learned event scoring was not a reliable solution in that older matched lineage. Those older architectures are context, not matched controls for the present step. No failed execution is recorded in current runtime; scientifically unsuccessful branches remain evidence. Current incumbent auxiliaries (cart/fav/buy AUC 0.74876/0.77476/0.75170) are materially below baseline-din (0.84907/0.86490/0.87018); this study claims only a validation click quality-cost question, not overall four-task dominance. Can target similarity be evaluated after slot compression with comparable click ranking and lower measured cost, and does the explicit similarity shortcut add value beyond the common correction inputs?
study.hypothesis: Per-event normalization may be unnecessary for the useful portion of the recent/feedback slot correction. Cosines of FP32 slot mean field keys retain target direction with fewer normalization rows (30 instead of 100), but discard mean unit-event direction and its coherence. A capacity-matched zero-channel control can distinguish the explicit shortcut from the shared correction. This is a conditional computational/information hypothesis, not an exact sufficient statistic or an originality claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary arXiv v4 text lines250-277 inspected: DIN target-dependent local activation and unnormalized weighted pooling are inherited concepts. This study evaluates normalization order in a thirty-slot correction, not a new attention principle or exact paper reproduction.

Pinned source 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d lines113-144 inspected: target-attention pooling precedes field/task token interactions. Current proposal retains the local slot/scorer/readouts and changes a bounded fieldwise similarity shortcut, without adopting HiFormer tokenization or blocks. Original HiFormer paper has not been audited; priority is unverified.

Closest local mechanism/code: keep the three selected descriptor groups, correction head, source gates and readouts; first prune unused moments, then move normalization after FP32 slot mean. This is a replacement contrast, not a claim that target-conditioned pooling is new.

inherited_components: Field/action embedding tables and frozen feature schema
Recent widths (20,20,20,20,10,5,2,1,1,1), feedback union and thirty all/nonfeedback/feedback means/counts
Occupied action-aware Dice scorer and cloned-buffer functional auxiliary call
Task heads, marginal age/behavior residuals and duplicated-union identity heads

study.proposed_difference: Standalone candidate uses cos(q,mean(raw key)) after compression rather than mean(cos(q,raw key)); all statistics remain FP32. No event second moment is computed in new modules. Serial legacy/event_first equivalence control and event_first/slot_first replacement identify execution pruning versus statistic construction; slot_null tests the shortcut at common nominal capacity and forward compute. No new external architecture is adopted.
predictions: Before full runs, event_first matches the legacy selected channels, outputs, gradients and persistent Dice updates within measured FP32/BF16 tolerances; otherwise the pruning claim is falsified.

Exploratory operational retention threshold: slot_first click AUC no more than 0.0002 below event_first with model batch p50 at least 10% lower, p95 no worse and full wall/GPU cost reported. This tolerance is a prospective selection rule, not significance or equivalence proof.
If the explicit normalized shortcut matters, slot_first should exceed slot_null at matched recipe, particularly in nonempty/long-history slices; a one-seed difference is only local observation.

Singleton nonzero field slots have equal event/slot cosines; heterogeneous multi-event slots can differ. For target e1 and events 2e1 and e2, event aligned mean=0.5 whereas slot cosine=2/sqrt(5). Empty slots give zero channels and zero correction contribution.
falsifiers: Any masking, source-gate, label-order, state-ownership, finite-gradient or API prerequisite fails: implementation inadmissible; no training until corrected.
event_first fails selected-output/gradient regression to the unmodified ancestor, invalidating equivalence attribution.
slot_first fails quality retention or measured latency criteria; the proposed efficiency implementation is unsupported.
slot_null matches/exceeds slot_first across paired follow-ups: no support for the explicit similarity shortcut conditional on the correction inputs.
The apparent advantage reverses across seeds or is driven by a narrow unsupported slice; no repeated mechanism conclusion.
alternative_explanations: Common correction capacity/context/count/age interactions explain gains rather than similarity.
Embedding norm heterogeneity and cancellation, rather than better target retrieval, explain stage differences.
Normalization epsilon produces unstable near-cancellation gradients; finite outputs alone are insufficient.
Single-seed stochasticity, host execution noise and validation selection over many rounds.
Small click ranking gains can accompany worse calibration or substantially weaker auxiliary predictions.
Stage replacement may move cost to FP32 slot BMM rather than saving it; fewer normalization rows is not measured efficiency.

variants.name: legacy_reference
variants.note: Unchanged selected ancestor, including unused event second-moment computations. Repetition is a regression/cost anchor at the frozen seed, not an independent seed replicate. Expected unchanged 32295406 total / 502190 dense / 31793216 embedding parameters, to be measured by host. Host prerequisites before any charged full run: finite FP32/BF16 forward/backward for full, partial, empty, holey and singleton histories, eval B=1 and frozen training batches; all four [B,1] probabilities under permuted label order. Verify padded item/action/task-mask perturbation invariance, target-action exclusion, overlapping task masks, thirty slot counts and assignment order, zero correction on inactive rows, zero-norm and near-cancelling field means, and gradients near normalization epsilon. Measure norm distributions; abort if finite/bounded-gradient checks fail rather than silently changing epsilon. Check identical inherited state keys/values, all new shapes and parameter counts, post-construction CPU RNG, source gates and optimizer ownership. Nonzero correction: auxiliary losses must not reach correction/scorer/item/action parameters, while click loss must; auxiliary context and readouts retain inherited gradients. Only primary Dice buffers may persist updates; preserve zero/one-row occupied scorer behavior and train/eval reuse. Local syntax/algebra checks cannot establish tensor correctness; abort and retain failed receipt on any failed prerequisite. Report full four-task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean, fixed history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts, examples processed, wall/train/allocated GPU seconds, peak memory, throughput and model-batch p50/p95 latency.
